name: smalltalk_refactor_extract_parameter_object
description: Gather some of the parameters of a method into an object of a new class, which the method then takes in their place, in the senders the scope takes in. The parameters are named, not numbered: where each one stands is what the method already says.

className.description: Name of the class that implements the method

selector.description: Selector of the method

newClassName.description: Name of the class the parameters are gathered into

parameterNames.description: Names of the parameters to gather, separated by commas

superclassName.description: Name of the superclass of the new class. It has to exist already

category.description: Class category to make the new class in. Defaults to the one of the class it came from

scope.description: Where the sends to change are looked for, around the class of the method: class, hierarchy, category, hierarchyAndCategories or system. category is the whole tree of the root class category, which is what a package usually is, but a class category tree does not always have a package of its own.
